about: Nicolás's retrieval set (php artisan assistant:retrieval): questions a student asks, each with the piece of the course the search must bring among the documents that go with it. No model is called and nothing is spent: it checks the index and the search alone, after every build of the index. «as» is who asks (full, modules:1,2, financials), «province» their province (its INE code), «expect» what one of the documents found must be: a lesson (its number), a module's own text (laws, where to go, summary, checklist), a course document, a template's card or the offices of the student's province for a module; «text» is a passage that document must contain. Add a case for each search that failed in the traces.
